board: Nibble Screen Connect (workbench5 SLOT14), running catalog MeshCore Companion 1.9.1 (HWCDC — enumerates as USB JTAG/serial debug unit)
measured: 2026-09-24, workbench5 via scripts/probe_bridge.py over ssh (LAN), flasher stub
chip: ESP32-S3 (QFN56) (revision v0.2), Embedded Flash 4MB (XMC) + Embedded PSRAM 2MB — same FH4R2 class as the Zero, no chip-level tell
notes: pins identical to a Nibble Zero EXCEPT GPIO1/GPIO2 (A/B buttons) read HIGH — both measured Zeros float there; used as an ordering preference between Zero and Screen Connect, not a verdict (n=1)
this MeshCore 1.9.1 build embeds no .pio/libdeps/ path at all, so the env layer returned null — the catalog ELF-hash layer (added because of this board) named it exactly
display (128x32 SSD1306) ACKs at 0x3C on SDA8/SCL7 like the Zero's 128x64 — display size is not readable over I2C
GPIO38 LOW / 39-40 HIGH again: ROM-mode JTAG artefacts on every S3 so far
